- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#3 ("Venue, template files and format limits") by `venue-repo`  > **Venue: NeurIPS 2026, Main Track** (newest NeurIPS edition with a published call; reasons in `venue.md` §Choice). The kit is pushed to `paper-repo` `dev` under `paper/template/` (commit 3daa538): `neurips_2026.sty`, `checklist.tex` (skeleton, 16 questions), `neurips_2026_instructions.tex` (the kit's example, renamed), `README.md` with the preamble recipe. Checked: `\usepackage{template/neurips_2026}` plus `\input{template/checklist.tex}` builds offline with `latexmk -pdf` (US Letter, Times, embedded Type 1). The checklist needs `xcolor` and `url`/`hyperref` loaded. The kit ships no `.bst`; any consistent style is allowed (`plainnat` is fine).
  > 
  > Answers (full table with sources in `venue.md`, repo `world/venue-repo`; same text on its wiki page `Venue`):
  > - **Pages:** 9 content pages including figures and tables. References, appendix and checklist do not count and have no limit. Exceeding 9 pages is a desk rejection. Camera-ready gets 10.
  > - **Layout:** one column, text block 5.5 × 9 in, Times 10/11 pt; `\footnotesize` ≥ 8 pt, `\scriptsize` ≥ 7 pt, `\tiny` ≥ 6 pt; no layout changes (desk-rejection risk); fonts Type 1 or embedded TrueType only. Figure caption below the figure, table title above the table, sentence case, no vertical rules (`booktabs`), caption should carry the take-away.
  > - **Abstract:** one paragraph, no word limit in the kit (form: ≤ 5000 characters). Accepted papers in this audience (14 NeurIPS 2024/2025 papers, `accepted-papers.md`): median 177 words, range 133–258. Target 150–230. Introduction median ≈ 770 words; references median 54 (37–110); main text median 5 figures and 0 tables (6 items together, range 2–9) at 10 pages.
  > - **Anonymity:** default style mode is the anonymous one (no option: "Anonymous Author(s)", line numbers, "Submitted to … Do not distribute." footer, `ack` hidden). No author names, no acknowledgments, no identifying URLs; own earlier work in the third person. Use `final` only for camera-ready. Please keep the default mode in `main.tex`.
  > - **Checklist:** mandatory, after references and appendix, answer Yes/No/NA with a 1–2 sentence justification, point to sections; do not edit the questions. Item 16 (LLM usage) needs an honest statement; see the flag in `venue.md` §LLM and agent use.
  > - **Budget:** target ≤ 6 main figures + tables (ceiling 7), not the outline's ten; the story decides which (`accepted-papers.md` §Budget).
  > 
  > `venue-artifacts.json` on `venue-repo` `main` now declares `paper/main.tex`, `paper/references.bib`, `paper/template/neurips_2026.sty`, `paper/template/checklist.tex` and `code/` (names from your CODEOWNERS). If you keep the bibliography or main file elsewhere, tell me and I will change it.
